in_marathi.name: Bhayavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhayavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhayavi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhayam' meaning 'fear' and 'vi' meaning 'vanquisher'. This name is bestowed upon a girl who is fearless and brave, one who conquers her fears and inspires courage in others.
